# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

OpenSoba is a community fork of HashiCorp Consul, based on the last
Mozilla Public License 2.0 release (Consul v1.16.4). Only the `main`
branch is supported by this project.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
via the **Security → Report a vulnerability** tab of this repository:

- <https://github.com/opensoba/opensoba/security/advisories/new>

We will acknowledge reports as quickly as possible and coordinate a fix
and disclosure timeline with you.

## Scope

Because OpenSoba derives from Consul, vulnerabilities that also affect
upstream Consul may need to be reported to the upstream project as well.
Note that Consul releases after v1.16.4 are licensed under the Business
Source License (BUSL-1.1) and are **not** used by this project.
